ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are schematic diagrams of the locations of two cities on the left and right. The left figure marks the 120° meridian and the latitude lines near 30° and 40°; city Jia is located in the coastal area near about 30°—40°N and 120°, and combining the land-sea outline it can be judged to be the coast of the east coast of a low- and middle-latitude continent. The right figure marks the 150° meridian and the latitude lines near 23°26′ and 30°; city Yi is located in the coastal area near about 23°26′—30°S and 150°, and combining the land-sea outline it can be judged to be the coast of the east coast of a low- and middle-latitude continent near the east coast of Australia. The two cities are in the Southern and Northern Hemispheres respectively, but both are located on the east coast of a low- and middle-latitude continent. Reasoning: The east coasts of low- and middle-latitude continents are obviously affected by monsoons or land-sea thermal differences; in the local summer, moist ocean airflow strengthens and precipitation is greater; in the local winter there is relatively less rain. Although Jia and Yi belong to different hemispheres, their rainy periods both correspond to their respective local summers, and both belong to the summer-rainy type. Therefore, the rainy periods of cities Jia and Yi are the same.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像中的两个定位图：甲在北半球东亚东部沿海约30°—40°N，乙在南半球澳大利亚东部沿海约23°26′—30°S。再根据两地都属于东岸季风性或湿润性气候区，判断其降水高峰都出现在当地夏季。由此回答甲、乙两城市的多雨期相同。
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中有两个定位小图。左图标出约30°—40°纬线和120°经线，甲位于北半球约30°—40°N的沿海地区，可对应东亚东部沿海一带。右图标出150°经线、23°26′和30°纬线，乙位于南半球澳大利亚东部沿海约23°26′—30°S之间。推理：甲、乙两地都位于大陆东岸的季风性或湿润性气候影响区，降水高峰都出现在当地夏季。因此从多雨期所属季节看，甲、乙两城市的多雨期相同。
method.CoT_answer_check_final: 图像描述：图中有两个定位小图。左图标出约30°—40°纬线和120°经线，甲位于北半球约30°—40°N的沿海地区，可对应东亚东部沿海一带。右图标出150°经线、23°26′和30°纬线，乙位于南半球澳大利亚东部沿海约23°26′—30°S之间。推理：甲、乙两地都位于大陆东岸的季风性或湿润性气候影响区，降水高峰都出现在当地夏季。因此从多雨期所属季节看，甲、乙两城市的多雨期相同。
method.CoT_qualify_0: 候选推理的最终答案与标准答案“相同”一致，也满足“先描述图像，再推理”的顺序，并基本照搬了方法草稿。但其关键图像解读/地理定位存在明显问题：左图的甲更应依据图中海陆位置和120°经线理解为北美洲西岸约30°—40°N、120°W附近，而不是“东亚东部沿海”。因此不能说甲、乙“两地都位于大陆东岸的季风性或湿润性气候影响区”，也不能说两地降水高峰都出现在“当地夏季”。建议修订为：先描述甲在北半球30°—40°N的大陆西岸约120°W附近、乙在南半球澳大利亚东部沿海约23°26′—30°S；再推理甲属地中海气候、北半球冬季多雨，乙在南半球夏季多雨，而二者对应的日历月份大致相同，所以多雨期相同。
method.CoT_after_polish_1: 图像描述：图中有两个定位小图。左图标有40°、30°纬线和120°经线，甲位于北半球30°—40°之间、约120°经线附近的大陆西岸沿海位置；结合海陆轮廓，可判断为北美洲西岸约120°W附近。右图标有150°经线、23°26′和30°纬线，乙位于南半球澳大利亚东部沿海约23°26′—30°S之间。推理：甲在北半球30°—40°大陆西岸，属地中海气候，主要在北半球冬季多雨；乙在澳大利亚东部沿海，南半球夏季降水较多。北半球冬季与南半球夏季对应的日历月份大致相同，所以从一年中的月份看，甲、乙两城市的多雨期相同。

method.method_draft: 先观察图像确认两城均在低中纬大陆东岸沿海，只是分处南、北半球。再用季节性风向和海陆热力差异解释：当地夏季海洋湿润气流加强，容易形成多雨期；当地冬季相对少雨。因为甲、乙的多雨期都对应当地夏季，所以判定多雨期相同。
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中有两个位置示意小图。左图城市甲位于约120°经线附近、30°—40°纬度之间的沿海地区；右图城市乙位于约150°经线附近、23°26′—30°纬度之间的沿海地区。两城市都在低中纬度大陆东岸沿海，但甲、乙分处南、北半球。推理：大陆东岸受海陆热力差异和季节性风向影响，当地夏季来自海洋的湿润气流增强，降水较多；当地冬季相对少雨。甲、乙虽然在不同半球，高温期对应的公历月份不同，但它们的降水季节类型都是当地夏季多雨。因此两城市的多雨期性质相同。

raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: In the figure there are schematic diagrams of the locations of two cities on the left and right. The left figure marks the 120° meridian and the latitude lines near 30° and 40°; city Jia is located in the coastal area near about 30°—40°N and 120°, and combining the land-sea outline it can be judged to be the coast of the east coast of a low- and middle-latitude continent. The right figure marks the 150° meridian and the latitude lines near 23°26′ and 30°; city Yi is located in the coastal area near about 23°26′—30°S and 150°, and combining the land-sea outline it can be judged to be the coast of the east coast of a low- and middle-latitude continent near the east coast of Australia. The two cities are in the Southern and Northern Hemispheres respectively, but both are located on the east coast of a low- and middle-latitude continent.
Reasoning: The east coasts of low- and middle-latitude continents are obviously affected by monsoons or land-sea thermal differences; in the local summer, moist ocean airflow strengthens and precipitation is greater; in the local winter there is relatively less rain. Although Jia and Yi belong to different hemispheres, their rainy periods both correspond to their respective local summers, and both belong to the summer-rainy type. Therefore, the rainy periods of cities Jia and Yi are the same.

The right figure marks the 150° meridian and the latitude lines near 23°26′ and 30°; city Yi is located in the coastal area near about 23°26′—30°S and 150°, and combining the land-sea outline it can be judged to be the coast of the east coast of a low- and middle-latitude continent near the east coast of Australia. The two cities are in the Southern and Northern Hemispheres respectively, but both are located on the east coast of a low- and middle-latitude continent.
Reasoning: The east coasts of low- and middle-latitude continents are obviously affected by monsoons or land-sea thermal differences; in the local summer, moist ocean airflow strengthens and precipitation is greater; in the local winter there is relatively less rain. Although Jia and Yi belong to different hemispheres, their rainy periods both correspond to their respective local summers, and both belong to the summer-rainy type. Therefore, the rainy periods of cities Jia and Yi are the same.
